```{.r .cell-code}
source(here::here("_defaults.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(ggdist)
library(mgcv)
library(tidytext)
library(geomtextpath)
box::use(v=vellumplot)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(friends)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
friends |> 
  distinct(
    season, episode
  ) |> 
  arrange(
    season, episode
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    ep = row_number()
  ) -> 
  total_ep


friends |> 
  left_join(total_ep) |> 
  filter(
    .by = speaker,
    n() > 7000
  ) |>
  unnest_tokens(
    word, text
  ) |> 
  count(
    speaker, season, episode, ep
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    .by = speaker,
    speaker = str_extract(speaker, "^\\w+\\b")
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = speaker,
    values_from = n
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    total = Chandler + Joey + Monica + Phoebe + Rachel + Ross,
    friend = cbind(Chandler, Joey, Monica, Phoebe, Rachel, Ross)
  ) ->
  words_df
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
brm(
  bf(
    friend | trials(total) ~ s(season) + (1|ep)
  ),
  family = multinomial(),
  data = words_df,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  cores = 4,
  file = "word_mod"
) ->
  word_mod
```
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
word_mod
```
